# ChartSeries

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the name, values, and optional style for one chart series.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ChartSeries(options?: ChartSeriesOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Series colour.
- [`dataPoints`](#datapoints): Data points for this series.
- [`name`](#name): Series name/label used in legends.
- [`seriesType`](#seriestype): Renderer role when used in ComboChart: `bar` (default), `line`, or `area`.
- [`style`](#style): Series-specific styling options.
- [`valueAxis`](#valueaxis): Value axis binding when used in ComboChart: `primary` (default) or `secondary`.

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Series colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/lab-report`:

```typescript
series.color = color;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/field-service-property/site-inspection-report`:

```typescript
series.color = ACCENT;
```

### `dataPoints`

```typescript
dataPoints: ChartDataPoint[]
```

Data points for this series.

> A list you can change.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bar-chart`:

```typescript
s.dataPoints = points;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/trend-charts/scatter-chart`:

```typescript
eu.dataPoints = [pt('n1', 120, 14, 12), pt('n2', 240, 21, 22), pt('n3', 360, 29, 34), pt('n4', 480, 41, 48)];
```

### `name`

```typescript
name: string
```

Series name/label used in legends.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/stacked-bar-chart`:

```typescript
s.name = name;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/waterfall-chart`:

```typescript
s.name = 'ARR';
```

### `seriesType`

```typescript
seriesType: ChartSeriesType
```

Renderer role when used in ComboChart: `bar` (default), `line`, or `area`.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/combo-chart`:

```typescript
revSeries.seriesType = 'bar';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/combo-chart`:

```typescript
marginSeries.seriesType = 'line';
```

### `style`

```typescript
style: ChartSeriesStyle
```

Series-specific styling options.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/combo-chart`:

```typescript
marginSeries.style = marginStyle;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/trend-charts/multi-series-line-chart`:

```typescript
currentYear.style = new ChartSeriesStyle({
  lineWidth: 2.5,
  markerShape: 'circle',
  markerHaloWidth: 1.5,
  markerRadius: 4.5,
});
```

### `valueAxis`

```typescript
valueAxis: ChartAxisTarget
```

Value axis binding when used in ComboChart: `primary` (default) or `secondary`.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/combo-chart`:

```typescript
revSeries.valueAxis = 'primary';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/combo-chart`:

```typescript
marginSeries.valueAxis = 'secondary';
```
